title: Unit Event — Farewell, My Mask

meta.Outline: As if losing her computer wasn't bad enough, Mafuyu feels her mother's grip tighten on her life, taking an increasing toll on her mental state. Amid all this, her teacher is due to return the results of a final...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That's it for Modern Japanese. Which just leaves math...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I should be able to solve this correctly as long as I follow this formula and don't make any calculation errors.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Lately, my concentration's been breaking over the smallest noises.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I struggled to focus even during finals the other day...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Mom must've been checking to see how I was doing... Because she's worried about me...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: How are your studies going, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Fine.
I should be able to get through everything that I need to do today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: However, it's getting late, so why don't you find a good spot to wrap things up? You need your rest.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You can always wake up early tomorrow morning to finish the rest. Also, here's some warm milk.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Speaking of which, you'll be getting your finals back tomorrow, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing good results since you studied so hard for them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Anyway, please try to go to bed soon. Good night.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The others are probably working right now...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I should sleep...
But I'm still nowhere near finished.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll keep working on these for a little while longer...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
I'll be returning your finals now.
Please come up when I call your name.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing good results since you studied so hard for them.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: To be honest, Asahina, you made quite a few more mistakes than usual. Is everything okay...?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Really? Well, my door's always open...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Mafuyu.
Do you get your finals back?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, the teachers are apparently very busy and need a little more time to grade them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
I understand they have tough jobs, but I hope they finish grading them soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I couldn't tell her about how I really did...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(But I won't be able to hide that forever...
I should tell her sooner rather than later.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'm afraid of what she's going to say when she sees that my grades are starting to slip.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Not just say... What she might do...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And I have another mock exam coming up.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Doing well on that might make up for how I did on my finals...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu sent us a message yesterday saying that she'll be taking a break from N25.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do you think's going on...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She had her synthesizer and computer taken away the other day, so something may have happened...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She said her test scores are starting to slip... She apparently thinks she needs to focus on studying in order to keep her mom from worrying even more.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Do you guys think her mom's at it again...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, we haven't heard many details other than this.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... After we told her to let us know if something happens...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm going to see how she's doing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If she is in pain, I want to be by her side...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, you're right. I'm sure she'll feel much better knowing you're there for her...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Please tell us if you hear anything.
We want to help if we can too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'll go tomorrow since she is probably already asleep...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll be sure to let you all know if I do hear anything.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, and it certainly seems like a fun place to be a student.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<More importantly...
Luka, why'd you follow us?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, there's no need to be so apprehensive.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm worried about Mafuyu. Just like all of you.>
Here are the worksheets you asked for.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Thank you, Asahina.
I really appreciate the help.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I was just fulfilling my duties as a class representative.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <She doesn't sound like her usual self...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, this is rather intriguing.
I'm glad I decided to follow all of you here♪>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Things are finally calm.
I need to hurry and start today's portion.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What are you all doing here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Kanade and the others were worried about you.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<So, Mafuyu...
Kanade told us that you needed to focus more on studying...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Is this because of something your mom said...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, it's not her...
It's...my own fault...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Like I told Kanade and the others, I didn't do very well on my finals... That's why I need to do something to make sure my mom doesn't start worrying even more about me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So that I can also keep making music with N25...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sorry, but I need to study. Thank you for coming to see me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Um, Mafuyu?
Would you mind if I stayed with you for a bit?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Next is calculus... These problems are usually fairly straightforward as long as you know what to do...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Okay, I'm done... But that took longer than expected...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I don't work faster, I won't be able to check over my solutions during tests.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I need to keep practicing these kinds of problems until I know them like the back of my hand...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (So that I can do better next time...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She looks like she's in so much pain...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Um, Mafuyu? How about you take a short break?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <What if you went to talk to Kanade and the others? They've been waiting very patiently for you.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have to study... I have to...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I see. I still don't quite fully understand, but studying must be very important to you, Mafuyu.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But in your current state, I feel that you won't be all that productive.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <As far as I can tell, you haven't been able to concentrate on your work. Doesn't that mean you should do something else instead?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes. To take your mind off of school. To clear your head...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Isn't it important to do that from time to time?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's been twenty minutes since lunch began... I guess Yuki isn't coming today either...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, someone just logged in. Is that...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Is everything okay?
You said you had to take a break from N25...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line:
<I can't stay long...
I'm just here to take a quick break.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, the rest of us should get to work! Our new song's actually almost finished!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I made this effect based on your lyrics, Yuki, and want to see what you think!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, me too.
Can you see if my rough sketch captures what you were going for with your lyrics?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Now that I'm hearing them together, these lyrics don't really work with this melody. Maybe I should go with something more straightforward...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, Enanan!
I need you to do a tiny favor for me!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're not talking about adding an extra section again, are you?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I am! I've got a feeling that the part during the chorus is gonna look even better if we added a cut where she extends her hand out!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Extend her hand out...?
With the current composition, that means I'm gonna have to draw all of that in.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know but it'll make Yuki's lyrics hit just that much harder!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hmm... Yeah, I get what you mean...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Wait, K, you do?
Then, I'll give it a try...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Just hearing their voices helps put my mind at ease...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You seem to be feeling a little better now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Interesting...
I think I'll need to adjust how to show it on screen a little.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Once Enanan's done making that hand asset we talked about, I'll try putting a cut together based on these lyrics!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<About that hand...
You know I pretty much have to draw it again from scratch, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Which is why you're the best!
Thanks for doing this, Enanan♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, now that the lyrics are done, I should be able to finish all my touch-ups today if I really try. We could conceivably be finished by tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, if we record the vocals today and edit everything tomorrow, I'd say it'll be ready for upload by that evening.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Then, tomorrow's all about cleaning it up. I'm almost done too, so I'll try doing what I can again tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <I don't know if I'll be here tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, right...
You still need to study.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Still, don't you want to finish what we've been working on together...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We'll let you know when we're about to upload it, so try to be there for that. I mean, it was a group effort...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <Then, I'll see what I can do...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <And I'll let you all know if I can't make it.>

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Thank you for coming all this way.
So, shall we get started?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Still, I feel terrible about asking you to meet with me so suddenly. I know parent-teacher conferences don't take place for some time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But my daughter's been behaving so oddly at home lately. It's really quite worrisome...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Which is why I was hoping to hear how she's been at school.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Ah, I see.
It's normal for a parent to be concerned about their child, so I understand.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Normal as far as I can tell...
She's been fulfilling her responsibilities as a class representative as always, and is adored by all her peers. I couldn't ask for a better student.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Was there anything else? I would appreciate anything you could share with me, even if it's minor...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Actually...
She did make quite a few mistakes on her finals. It was strange to see...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: To be fair, we all have our bad days, so I'm sure it's no cause for concern.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: It's just... She hardly ever makes careless mistakes like that, so–

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Excuse me. What are you talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You've already finished grading her finals?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Huh? Yes, I handed them back the other day... I assumed she'd already told you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hello?
Yes, this is Mafuyu Asahina's mother.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I apologize for calling you so suddenly.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right...
How has Mafuyu been acting lately?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. She's always working very hard, so I'll remind her that she needs to take breaks on occasion...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: (She hid how she did on her finals from me and didn't show up for cram school...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: (If this keeps up, she's going to lose focus and not do as well as she needs to on her entrance exams...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: (Which means she won't get accepted to her top choice.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That is simply not an option...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It was nice to get to work with everyone today after so long...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But because of that, I wasn't able to go through the section that I planned to. I need to study when I get home...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I also need to review these sorts of problems again. I made too many mistakes on my final...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I have to do better next time...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm doing okay.
Is there something you need, Mom?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I hate to interrupt you while you're studying, but there's something I forgot to ask you during dinner.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
So, what is it that you need to ask me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I feel that you should've gotten them back by now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I haven't gotten them back yet...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, but I should be getting them back soon. Again, the teachers are all very busy with...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
That's strange.
Your teacher told me a different story.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I went over to your school to talk to them today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: About you and about how you did on your finals...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How I did on my finals...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Why didn't you tell me sooner...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I did so poorly that...
I was afraid to tell you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Thank you for being honest with me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But I'd really rather you told me these things without hesitating. There's no need to hide anything from me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I understand that it must've been a little difficult to get a hold of me recently since I've also been busy with things. I'm sorry about that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
What's done is done...
So, let's discuss your plan moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, since you'll need to study even more to make up for the ground you've lost.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: For the time being, you may want to reduce the time you spend on extracurricular activities.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Right...
I was thinking the same thing in terms of making up for what happened.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: In that case, I doubt you'll be needing your phone.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Why...?
Because it's a distraction. It'll keep you from focusing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, I'll be fine...
My phone shouldn't affect how I study.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I promise to keep my grades from slipping even further...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I called your cram school teacher and they told me that you missed class the other day because “you weren't feeling well”...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: From what I recall, you didn't come home until quite late that day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I understand your desire to spend time with your friends. When I was your age, all I wanted to was go out and do things with them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: However, those sorts of distractions will prevent you from focusing on your studies...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: At this rate, you may not do very well on your next mock exam... Which means you may not do well on the real thing. If that were to happen...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You won't be able to make your dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes. You wouldn't want that to happen, do you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So, I'll be taking your phone for safekeeping.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: In exchange, I'll give you a phone that can only make calls. You'll still be able to reach me with that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Mafuyu.
I'll return it to you when it actually becomes necessary.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So, I'll be taking this from–

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I promise to study and do better! So please! Anything but my phone...! Because without this, I...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Like I just said, this won't do you any good right now. Why can't you see that...?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My friends have nothing to do with my grades slipping! That happened because I...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
No, I know that's not true.
Because nothing like this ever happened until recently...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Which means... It's her fault! That Yoisaki girl...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How do you know about Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I felt the need to see what your so-called friend is like...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Does that mean you met her...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Why?
What did you even talk about?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: None of that matters right now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, stop...!
Please, anything but this!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I didn't mean for this to happen...
I wasn't hoping that your phone would break...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'll make sure to buy you a new one by the time you've taken your mock exam...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So, let's both just try to calm ourselves down. For now, you should rest.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Now, this problem can be solved by...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't think there's any point in lying to her anymore...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Should I do as she says...?
And quit N25...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I do that, I won't get to see everyone... Or go to SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I won't get to see Miku or the others...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Let's see... Asahina, try solving this one for us.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Hey, Mafuyu!
Wanna have lunch in the courtyard with us?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I'll be eating by myself today. There's something I need to do.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Okay, that's too bad!
I guess you have been pretty busy lately.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry.
I hope you'll invite me again some other time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The others are probably working right now...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I wish I could work with them...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It managed to get power this morning, but it's still stuck on the home screen.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Like I just said, this won't do you any good right now. Why can't you see that...?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: All I'm trying to do is make sure you have the best future possible...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (D-Does she actually have my best interests in mind...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But... But I care about everyone in N25...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She's doing everything she can to destroy who you really are. How can you even think about showing her any mercy?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That doesn't explain why she keeps taking everything away from me.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu didn't end up joining us during lunch...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Without saying a word too. Something's gotta be up. You don't think...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Her mom probably did something again...
What if she finally decided to take away her phone...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't know, but let's all take a step back for a second...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Miku went to see what's going on, so I'm sure she'll have some news for us soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Right...
I really hope everything's okay...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You couldn't reach it...?
What do you mean? Why?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Something may've happened to her phone.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We're able to see what's going on over in your world by using the functionality of your phones.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, does this mean her phone's broken?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
B-But, I mean... Now?
That seems like way too big a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm going to go look for Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm going too...
Not being able to reach her means something's definitely wrong.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Still, where?
I guess her house is the best place to start...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But we don't know where she lives.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Regardless, I'll try some places where she'll most likely be. We might be able to find her if all three of us look...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Then, I'll try Miya Girls.
She might still be at school.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll check the station.
We run into each other a lot there on her way home from cram school.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll try going over to her phone again...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I don't know if it's going to work...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, there's too many people. I'm never gonna find her here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay...
I didn't find her over here either.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I tried asking some Miya Girls students about her just now, but they said she's already gone home.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'll check the diner just in case.
There's a chance that she'll stop there before going home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I really don't want to go home...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I tried going to the diner...
But I didn't see Kanade and the others there.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Which is normal since it's not like we made plans to have an after-party there or anything...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I have that mock exam soon.
I need to study for it.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What am I supposed to tell her...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That I want to keep making music with my group?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But she's never going to let me...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Is there anything I can do at this point...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Now I get it. We couldn't reach you because your phone was broken...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was worried I'd never see you again...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
My mom tried to take away my phone...
I resisted and...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Mafuyu...
If you don't fight back now, this is probably going to be it for you.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm not just talking about being cut off from everyone. She's going to pick you apart clean.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <If you agree to do her bidding, she'll succeed in destroying who you are.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You'll lose everything that you care about. For good.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What am I supposed to do...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Fight back. Tell her how you really feel.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <No one can predict what's going to happen, but this is the only option you have right now.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If I do that, Mom will...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <If you tell her, she might get upset...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But if you don't say something, you might break...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<I don't want that to happen...
So, please, tell her.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll try telling her how I really feel.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, welcome back.
You're home late.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I needed some time to think...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I see...
Well, things have been a little hectic lately.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I wanted to apologize for going a little too far yesterday. So, I made the beef stew you like so much for dinner.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I bought some higher-quality meat than usual, so I'm sure it turned out very nicely. Eat as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Before that, there's something I need to tell you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Something to tell me? Yes, what is it...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry for hiding so many things from you until now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry for continuing to make music after saying that I'd stop, and not telling you about my finals...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know that you're worried about me, and you have every right to be angry.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But I'm glad you finally understand.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I need to ask you something.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I promise to study as hard as I can... So please...
Let me keep making music with Kanade and the others.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'll make sure my grades won't slip.
You don't have to worry.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: If you're willing to say this much...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: This music you make must mean quite a lot to you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, it's very important to me! So...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I agree that you have a wonderful hobby. So, I'm not against your wish to continue with it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Is now really the time for that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
This goes without saying, Mafuyu...
You know that you have to make sacrifices if you really wish to get accepted into medical school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: What do you think is going to happen if you don't put all of your energy into your entrance exams?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Your peers are all doing everything in their power to maintain good grades, while yours are slipping...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: At this rate, Mafuyu, you won't be able to make your dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
Your dreams mean everything to you, yes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So, for now, you'll just have to be patient, and study and work towards that goal...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure if I actually want to become a doctor...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
What do you mean?
It's always been your dream to become a doctor. That's why you've been studying so hard.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It's why you've been attending cram school and staying up late each night...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I admire doctors greatly since they save people's lives and help those in pain...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd also be able to live very comfortably and not have to worry about my finances...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, I understand why someone would want to become a doctor.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to do more for others...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to be right by their side when they're in pain...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But... You can do that as a doctor, no...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But... I don't think I actually want to become one...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mom, do you remember what happened when I was little?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I caught a cold and you stayed by my side until I got better.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I know now that the medicine the doctor prescribed helped me get better...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But more than that... The way you stayed by my side... It filled me with so much warmth...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Which is why I want to help others the same way... I want them to feel that warmth...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to spend more time finding a dream that suits me better...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I see. Now I understand, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: How can you say such a thing...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: How did things end up like this...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Mafuyu, you spent so much time studying and working so hard to become a doctor...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But now... You want to give up... You're willing to let some passing fancy derail you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: And that girl is definitely to blame.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: She only seems to do as she pleases without studying or going to school...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You felt some admiration for that lifestyle, didn't you, Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Kanade has nothing to do with this...
Mom, I...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: This would've never happened if I supported you more properly...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I know I've sounded overbearing at times and kept you from doing certain things...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: As a result, I was probably much harder on you compared to other mothers.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: However, I did it all for your sake...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I was only thinking about you having a happy and fulfilling future...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Because... That's what will make me happy...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I... I didn't mean to hurt you...
This wasn't what I wanted...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was just trying to tell you how I feel...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Mom cares this much about me...
She just said so herself...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <How you feel right now... That's what the real you wants.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you cry and feel so sad.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want you to know how I really feel...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've been in so much pain this entire time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You placed such high expectations on me, and I did my best to not disappoint you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
The more I tried, the worse I felt...
Eventually, I began wondering if this is really what I wanted to do...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But as I worked with Kanade and the others... Little by little, I began to understand...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm beginning to realize what I truly want to do...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know you're not going to like hearing this, Mom, but I... I don't want to lose them...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't want to give up music, or not see them ever again...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't want either of those things to happen...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Why don't you understand what I'm trying to say...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: How many times do I have to tell you? Making music and being with your so-called friends... Those are just passing fancies.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: If you keep running from the things that matter most, you're absolutely going to regret it later on...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It'll be too late by the time you realize that you should've studied a little harder back then.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But Kanade and the others too...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I promise to keep studying!
In return for letting me do this, I promise to become the daughter that you'll be proud of!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: And this is why I'm telling you that you don't understand!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Buying you that computer, letting you use that blasted instrument... It was all a mistake!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I look away for one second and you start making your own music.
For two years, you hid so many things from me, neglected your studies and became “friends” with complete strangers you met on the internet!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: If I had known this would happen, I would've never given you any of those things!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That girl... She doesn't know what's best for you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Is she really saying all these things because she wants what's best for me...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Even after you get home, you probably won't be able to take your mind off things...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But we'll always be on your side.
So...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All of us in N25... We'll always be waiting for you in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know things aren't gonna be easy now that your mom knows about N25, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You need to speak up if something really bothers you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because you're the only one who can protect yourself in the end...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I remembered how my dad said that he wanted to make me and my mom smile by playing this song he wrote for us.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
When we heard it...
We couldn't help but smile and laugh.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want you to feel what I did. I want you to smile the way I did back then.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I feel so much warmth when I'm with them...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't know... I can't say for certain...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't want this feeling to go away...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I apologize for raising my voice like that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll understand, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Because you're such a good, kind girl who I know will do the right thing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Wait, but... My chest feels...tight... And my head is starting to hurt...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I'm sorry... I was in the wrong...?
But, no... I can't...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: When you think you've reached your limit, I say run. Get out while you can.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: For your own sake, Mafuyu. You. No one else.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But is it really okay for me to run...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I do... What's going to happen to Mom...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I leave her behind... She'll... I... But...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
So, let's start over.
I promise to do what I can for you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Luka said that she's going to try talking to her mom after she gets home...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But trying to get through to her seems...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I told her...!
I told my mom how I really felt!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
She was so angry...
And had such a sad look on her face...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Was I the one... Completely in the wrong?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Nothing... Nothing makes sense to me anymore...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's all right... You're going to be okay...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes... Yes, fine...
Until things settle down...
